item_short_desc: Rothco’s Aluminum Canteen Cup is a durable and practical addition to any outdoor, camping, or bug-out kit. With an 18oz capacity, it’s perfect for heating water, preparing food, or simply drinking when you’re on the go. The canteen cup is designed to fit perfectly under Rothco’s Aluminum Canteen, making it a versatile companion for your hydration gear. Its sturdy folding handle offers both a comfortable grip and compact storage, allowing you to easily carry it in your pack without taking up too much space.
